baseline.name: Check all index pairs for nums[i] > 2*nums[j]
baseline.approach: Enumerate i<j and count the pairs satisfying the widened arithmetic comparison.

archived.name: Merge-sort counting with a monotone cross-half pointer
archived.space: O(n) shared temporary array plus O(log n) recursion depth

why: Sorted halves let one pointer count a whole run of qualifying right-side values instead of revisiting every cross pair.
quantitative_comparison: The pair baseline evaluates n(n-1)/2 inequalities. Merge counting performs O(n) pointer/merge work per recursion level over O(log n) levels. Those are different operation families, so no fixed millisecond speedup is inferred.
tradeoffs: Adds O(n) temporary memory and sorts the input. Allocation failure returns zero and int result capacity depends on the judged length bound.
evidence_basis: Static source inspection and stated algorithm work/storage model. Comparator is an analytical alternative, not an implemented or timed benchmark. Historical platform acceptance is separate from current local validation.
